structure.raw_value: ArWoCl.I sense guilt in your heart. What have you done?
structure.script_literal: "ArWoCl.I sense guilt in your heart. What have you done?"

translation: Wyczuwam w twoim sercu poczucie winy. Co zrobiłeś?

source_text: Nothing.

structure.raw_value: McWoDe.Nothing.
structure.script_literal: "McWoDe.Nothing."

translation: Nic.

source_text: You can not hide your feelings from me, 1Hero.

structure.raw_value: ArSaEx.You can not hide your feelings from me, 1Hero.
structure.script_literal: "ArSaEx.You can not hide your feelings from me, 1Hero."

translation: Nie ukryjesz przede mną swoich uczuć, 1Hero.

source_text: My lead for the Wilkes case got away, I lost to a skinny asshole and I saw my boss naked…

structure.raw_value: McAnDe.My lead for the Wilkes case got away, I lost to a skinny asshole and I saw my boss naked…
structure.script_literal: "McAnDe.My lead for the Wilkes case got away, I lost to a skinny asshole and I saw my boss naked…"

translation: Uciekł mi podejrzany w sprawie Wilkesów, przegrałem z chudym dupkiem i zobaczyłem nagą szefową…

source_text: You tell me what’s on my heart.

structure.raw_value: McAnEx.You tell me what’s on my heart.
structure.script_literal: "McAnEx.You tell me what’s on my heart."

translation: Sama powiedz, co mi leży na sercu.

source_text: Oh, my! A series of unfortunate events, for sure.

structure.raw_value: ArWoCl.Oh, my! A series of unfortunate events, for sure.
structure.script_literal: "ArWoCl.Oh, my! A series of unfortunate events, for sure."

translation: Ojej! Niezła seria niefortunnych zdarzeń.

source_text: I will help you with the Wilkes case, but I can not help you with stinky buttholes or nude overseers.

structure.raw_value: ArBaEx.I will help you with the Wilkes case, but I can not help you with stinky buttholes or nude overseers.
structure.script_literal: "ArBaEx.I will help you with the Wilkes case, but I can not help you with stinky buttholes or nude overseers. "

translation: Pomogę ci w sprawie Wilkesów, ale nie poradzę nic na śmierdzące tyłki ani nagich przełożonych.

source_text: I said skinny asshole. Not stinky asshole.

structure.raw_value: McAnEx.I said skinny asshole. Not stinky asshole.
structure.script_literal: "McAnEx.I said skinny asshole. Not stinky asshole."

translation: Powiedziałem „chudy dupek”, nie „śmierdzący dupek”.

source_text: It sounds like your world has an abundance of unique butt problems…

structure.raw_value: ArWoCl.It sounds like your world has an abundance of unique butt problems…
structure.script_literal: "ArWoCl.It sounds like your world has an abundance of unique butt problems…"

translation: Wygląda na to, że w twoim świecie nie brakuje rozmaitych problemów z tyłkami…

source_text: An unfortunate outcome of human kind’s fall from grace.

structure.raw_value: ArSaEx.An unfortunate outcome of human kind’s fall from grace.
structure.script_literal: "ArSaEx.An unfortunate outcome of human kind’s fall from grace."

translation: Niefortunny skutek upadku człowieka.

source_text: Fall from grace?

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.Fall from grace?
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.Fall from grace?"

translation: Upadku człowieka?

source_text: The mother of your kind, Eve…

structure.raw_value: ArFrEx.The mother of your kind, Eve…
structure.script_literal: "ArFrEx.The mother of your kind, Eve…"

translation: Ewa, matka twojego rodzaju…

source_text: She was a naughty girl.

structure.raw_value: ArSaEx.She was a naughty girl.
structure.script_literal: "ArSaEx.She was a naughty girl."

translation: Była niegrzeczną dziewczynką.

source_text: Are you telling me the story from Genesis is true?

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.Are you telling me the story from Genesis is true?
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.Are you telling me the story from Genesis is true?"

translation: Chcesz mi powiedzieć, że historia z Księgi Rodzaju jest prawdziwa?

source_text: Do you find it hard to believe?

structure.raw_value: ArBaOp.Do you find it hard to believe?
structure.script_literal: "ArBaOp.Do you find it hard to believe?"

translation: Trudno ci w to uwierzyć?

source_text: A talking snake, a poison apple… I would say it’s unbelievable…

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.A talking snake, a poison apple… I would say it’s unbelievable…
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.A talking snake, a poison apple… I would say it’s unbelievable…"

translation: Mówiący wąż, zatrute jabłko… Powiedziałbym, że to niewiarygodne…

source_text: But then again, I’m talking to an angel. So, who am I to judge?

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.But then again, I’m talking to an angel. So, who am I to judge?
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.But then again, I’m talking to an angel. So, who am I to judge?"

translation: Ale z drugiej strony rozmawiam z aniołem. Kimże jestem, żeby to oceniać?

source_text: When the Lord created mankind, his creation, Eve, disobeyed his orders.

structure.raw_value: ArSaEx.When the Lord created mankind, his creation, Eve, disobeyed his orders.
structure.script_literal: "ArSaEx.When the Lord created mankind, his creation, Eve, disobeyed his orders."

translation: Gdy Pan stworzył ludzkość, Ewa, jego dzieło, nie posłuchała jego rozkazów.

source_text: I know the story.

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.I know the story.
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.I know the story."

translation: Znam tę historię.

source_text: Then you know why you’re doomed to a life of misery.

structure.raw_value: ArSaEx.Then you know why you’re doomed to a life of misery.
structure.script_literal: "ArSaEx.Then you know why you’re doomed to a life of misery."

translation: A więc wiesz, dlaczego czeka cię życie pełne cierpienia.

source_text: Eve ate the fruit of knowledge.

structure.raw_value: ArSaOp.Eve ate the fruit of knowledge.
structure.script_literal: "ArSaOp.Eve ate the fruit of knowledge."

translation: Ewa zjadła owoc poznania.

source_text: Not all of life is misery, Arianna.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Not all of life is misery, Arianna.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.Not all of life is misery, Arianna."

translation: Nie całe życie jest pasmem cierpień, Arianno.

source_text: A story about knowledge being the enemy sounds like brainwashing to me.

structure.raw_value: McFlDe.A story about knowledge being the enemy sounds like brainwashing to me.
structure.script_literal: "McFlDe.A story about knowledge being the enemy sounds like brainwashing to me."

translation: Opowieść, w której wiedza jest wrogiem, brzmi jak pranie mózgu.

source_text: Brainwashing!? Do you think I’m brainwashed?

structure.raw_value: ArWoCl.Brainwashing!? Do you think I’m brainwashed?
structure.script_literal: "ArWoCl.Brainwashing!? Do you think I’m brainwashed?"

translation: Pranie mózgu!? Myślisz, że ktoś wyprał mi mózg?

source_text: No way. You seem perfectly normal and not at all naive.

structure.raw_value: McFlEx.No way. You seem perfectly normal and not at all naive.
structure.script_literal: "McFlEx.No way. You seem perfectly normal and not at all naive."

translation: Skądże. Wydajesz się zupełnie normalna i wcale naiwna.

source_text: Thank you, 1Hero! You’re so kind!

structure.raw_value: ArHaAg.Thank you, 1Hero! You’re so kind!
structure.script_literal: "ArHaAg.Thank you, 1Hero! You’re so kind!"

translation: Dziękuję, 1Hero! Jesteś taki miły!

source_text: Why do I feel like the middleman all of a sudden?

structure.raw_value: McSaDe.Why do I feel like the middleman all of a sudden?
structure.script_literal: "McSaDe.Why do I feel like the middleman all of a sudden?"

translation: Dlaczego nagle czuję się jak pośrednik?

source_text: What’s wrong, 1Hero? I sense conflict.

structure.raw_value: ArWoCl.What’s wrong, 1Hero? I sense conflict.
structure.script_literal: "ArWoCl.What’s wrong, 1Hero? I sense conflict."

translation: Co się stało, 1Hero? Wyczuwam, że coś cię dręczy.

source_text: Where do I start? I’m walking a tightrope between Melissa and Andrea while also balancing Heather and Chloe on my shoulders.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.Where do I start? I’m walking a tightrope between Melissa and Andrea while also balancing Heather and Chloe on my shoulders.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.Where do I start? I’m walking a tightrope between Melissa and Andrea while also balancing Heather and Chloe on my shoulders."

translation: Od czego zacząć? Chodzę po linie między Melissą a Andreą, a do tego dźwigam na barkach Heather i Chloe.

source_text: That’s incredible! You are a man of many talents.

structure.raw_value: ArShAg.That’s incredible! You are a man of many talents.
structure.script_literal: "ArShAg.That’s incredible! You are a man of many talents."

translation: Niesamowite! Masz wiele talentów.

source_text: I don’t mean it literally… I mean, my relationships are getting complicated.

structure.raw_value: McAnEx.I don’t mean it literally… I mean, my relationships are getting complicated.
structure.script_literal: "McAnEx.I don’t mean it literally… I mean, my relationships are getting complicated."

translation: Nie mówię dosłownie… Chodzi mi o to, że moje relacje robią się coraz bardziej skomplikowane.

source_text: Oh, I see.

structure.raw_value: ArBaDe.Oh, I see.
structure.script_literal: "ArBaDe.Oh, I see."

translation: A, rozumiem.

source_text: I feel like no matter what I do, someone’s going to get upset.

structure.raw_value: McSaDe.I feel like no matter what I do, someone’s going to get upset.
structure.script_literal: "McSaDe.I feel like no matter what I do, someone’s going to get upset."

translation: Mam wrażenie, że cokolwiek zrobię, ktoś się obrazi.

source_text: You carry a lot of burden, but do not forget your purpose…

structure.raw_value: ArSaEx.You carry a lot of burden, but do not forget your purpose…
structure.script_literal: "ArSaEx.You carry a lot of burden, but do not forget your purpose…"

translation: Dźwigasz wielki ciężar, ale nie zapominaj o swoim przeznaczeniu…

source_text: A grave evil is upon us, and only you can stop it.

structure.raw_value: ArWoEx.A grave evil is upon us, and only you can stop it.
structure.script_literal: "ArWoEx.A grave evil is upon us, and only you can stop it."

translation: Zagraża nam straszliwe zło i tylko ty możesz je powstrzymać.

source_text: Thanks, Arianna. I feel so much better now.

structure.raw_value: McAnDe.Thanks, Arianna. I feel so much better now.
structure.script_literal: "McAnDe.Thanks, Arianna. I feel so much better now."

translation: Dzięki, Arianno. Od razu mi lepiej.

source_text: Wonderful! A healthy mind is a healthy soul.

structure.raw_value: ArHaAg.Wonderful! A healthy mind is a healthy soul.
structure.script_literal: "ArHaAg.Wonderful! A healthy mind is a healthy soul."

translation: Wspaniale! W zdrowym umyśle zdrowa dusza.

source_text: Who’s calling me? I wonder if Melissa is mad I’m not in the office.

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.Who’s calling me? I wonder if Melissa is mad I’m not in the office.
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.Who’s calling me? I wonder if Melissa is mad I’m not in the office."

translation: Kto dzwoni? Ciekawe, czy Melissa jest zła, że nie ma mnie w biurze.

source_text: 1Hero. We have a problem.

structure.raw_value: AdBaEx.1Hero. We have a problem.
structure.script_literal: "AdBaEx.1Hero. We have a problem."

translation: 1Hero. Mamy problem.

source_text: Tell me about it. I saw Kimberly at the mansion.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.Tell me about it. I saw Kimberly at the mansion.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.Tell me about it. I saw Kimberly at the mansion."

translation: Mów mi. Widziałem Kimberly w rezydencji.

source_text: She wanted an interview and she came to the station.

structure.raw_value: AdBaEx.She wanted an interview and she came to the station.
structure.script_literal: "AdBaEx.She wanted an interview and she came to the station."

translation: Chciała przeprowadzić wywiad, więc przyszła na posterunek.

source_text: Do you want me back at the station?

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.Do you want me back at the station?
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.Do you want me back at the station?"

translation: Mam wracać na posterunek?

source_text: No. I convinced her to meet at my house. I don’t want that woman anywhere near the station or the mansion.

structure.raw_value: AdAnEx.No. I convinced her to meet at my house. I don’t want that woman anywhere near the station or the mansion.
structure.script_literal: "AdAnEx.No. I convinced her to meet at my house. I don’t want that woman anywhere near the station or the mansion."

translation: Nie. Namówiłam ją, żeby spotkała się ze mną w domu. Nie chcę jej ani w pobliżu posterunku, ani rezydencji.

source_text: I can head over. When is the meeting?

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.I can head over. When is the meeting?
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.I can head over. When is the meeting?"

translation: Mogę przyjechać. O której spotkanie?

source_text: Let’s not be too formal. I invited her over for drinks.

structure.raw_value: AdFlEx.Let’s not be too formal. I invited her over for drinks.
structure.script_literal: "AdFlEx.Let’s not be too formal. I invited her over for drinks."

translation: Nie bądźmy tacy oficjalni. Zaprosiłam ją na drinka.

source_text: Let’s stay on her good side.

structure.raw_value: AdFlEx.Let’s stay on her good side.
structure.script_literal: "AdFlEx.Let’s stay on her good side."

translation: Lepiej nie zrażać jej do siebie.

source_text: I get it. When should I be there?

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.I get it. When should I be there?
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.I get it. When should I be there?"

translation: Rozumiem. Kiedy mam przyjechać?

source_text: I need something from you.

structure.raw_value: AdBaEx.I need something from you.
structure.script_literal: "AdBaEx.I need something from you."

translation: Potrzebuję, żebyś coś dla mnie zrobił.

source_text: You’re near the mansion, correct?

structure.raw_value: AdBaOp.You’re near the mansion, correct?
structure.script_literal: "AdBaOp.You’re near the mansion, correct?"

translation: Jesteś niedaleko rezydencji, prawda?

source_text: I’m making a very special drink and I need raw aloe.

structure.raw_value: AdBaEx.I’m making a very special drink and I need raw aloe.
structure.script_literal: "AdBaEx.I’m making a very special drink and I need raw aloe."

translation: Przygotowuję wyjątkowy napój i potrzebuję świeżego aloesu.

source_text: A drink with aloe?

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.A drink with aloe?
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.A drink with aloe?"

translation: Napój z aloesem?

source_text: It’s… a special mixture.

structure.raw_value: AdFrEx.It’s… a special mixture.
structure.script_literal: "AdFrEx.It’s… a special mixture."

translation: To… specjalna mieszanka.

source_text: The plant grows out west. Grab one and come over…

structure.raw_value: AdBaEx.The plant grows out west. Grab one and come over…
structure.script_literal: "AdBaEx.The plant grows out west. Grab one and come over…"

translation: Ta roślina rośnie na zachodzie. Zerwij jedną i przyjedź…

source_text: Kimberly will be here when you arrive.

structure.raw_value: AdBaOp.Kimberly will be here when you arrive.
structure.script_literal: "AdBaOp.Kimberly will be here when you arrive."

translation: Kiedy przyjedziesz, Kimberly już tu będzie.

source_text: Don’t linger.

structure.raw_value: AdAnOp.Don’t linger.
structure.script_literal: "AdAnOp.Don’t linger."

translation: Nie ociągaj się.

source_text: I guess Andrea is trying to make a good impression on Kimberly.

structure.raw_value: McBaDe^.I guess Andrea is trying to make a good impression on Kimberly.
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe^.I guess Andrea is trying to make a good impression on Kimberly."

translation: Chyba Andrea próbuje zrobić dobre wrażenie na Kimberly.

source_text: If we’re going to convince Kimberly to look the other way, this better be one hell of a drink.

structure.raw_value: McWoOp^.If we’re going to convince Kimberly to look the other way, this better be one hell of a drink.
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp^.If we’re going to convince Kimberly to look the other way, this better be one hell of a drink."

translation: Jeśli mamy przekonać Kimberly, żeby przymknęła oko, ten drink musi być naprawdę mocny.
